name: o28210

schema.description: An assignment made by the Seller of a SVLAN ID to a UNI or ENNI endpoint.

objectType.description: The type of the object, svlanIdAssignment.

sellerEnniId.description: The id assigned by the Seller for the ENNI for this SVLAN ID assignment.

sellerUniId.description: The id assigned by the Seller for the UNI for this SVLAN ID assignment.

svlanId.description: The SVLAN ID assigned to this UNI or ENNI

schema.title: svlanIdAssignment

description:
Subject: Confirmation of SVLAN ID Assignment  

Dear Team,

Please be advised that a new SVLAN ID assignment has been created under the object type **svlanIdAssignment**. The allocated SVLAN ID is **1024**. For reference, the seller‑assigned identifiers for the associated endpoints are as follows: the ENNI endpoint carries the ID **ENNI-12345-ABCD**, and the UNI endpoint is identified by **UNI-67890-XYZ**.  

Kindly update the relevant configuration records to reflect this assignment. Let me know if any further details are required.
